oracle: All 30 stages x seeds 1,3,7 (90 runs) win with legitimate purchased/earned gear, finite score, no timeout and production onResult reward bounds.
implementation: Each shot stops at first hull. Kind-1 purchased/earned lasers convert the exact laser coefficient already used by enemy HP scaling, through the same HP exponent, into first-hull damage. Kind-0 cannon, temporary laser without that HP coefficient, kind-2 volley and AoE damage stay unchanged.
limitation: A deterministic attentive pilot with high earned/purchased gear; this is not a beginner or physical-phone win rate.

baseline.pilot: every-frame predictive dodge, lowest target, both fire buttons and missiles
baseline.scope: All 90 recorded runs with earned/purchased gear won; the final C-progression test requires 90/90. This is not a beginner win-rate claim.
